history.subject: Wave 2b, the dévissage short-exact sequence and the jump dimension: the sequence 0 → O(D−x) → O(D) → skyscraper_x(jump) → 0 is short exact (devissageSES_shortExact — epi via local surjectivity of the projection, excising the finite bad locus and lifting a jump-class representative; middle exactness sectionwise through the pole-lattice/jumpProj equivalence, transported to the sheaf level by limit-reflection), and the jump module is the residue field as a K-space so its dimension is the residue degree (finrank_jumpModule via the uniformizer-shift isomorphism O(D)_x/O(D−x)_x ≅ κ(x) and the first isomorphism theorem). Plus the divisor-sheaf multiplication equivalence mulEquivDivisorSheaf toward the principal-divisor degree identity. G7 closed and G8's multiplication piece landed. Design: (C2) effectivity-campaign recon — the honest remaining content after the G3 correction is a single effectivity brick, the exact dual of the landed (C1) Čech kernel lemma: a rigidified class on the curve over an étale cover whose two double-cover pullbacks agree on the nose descends along the cover inclusion on the curve product. Terrain mapped: the rigidification layer and picEtUnit are landed and hand over the descent equation directly; the section is genuinely needed (class equation ⇒ existence-only comparison; σ-normalization via the landed lm:aut bijectivity supplies the coherence the (C1) side got from its trivialization); the curve product over the cover is NOT affine, so the dictionary and brick-4 descent apply only piece-by-piece on cg-saturated affine opens — and the local-to-global reassembly on curve opens (A4) has no landed primitive, the least-charted step. Five core gaps R0/A1/A2/A3/A4 with (C1)-mirror tags (A2 = the coherent-cochain heart, mirror of exists_coherentCechWitness); Kleiman's Part-2 argument re-read with line anchors and the cocycle-model divergence recorded; Route A (per-piece) vs Route B (global unit) trade-offs left to the worksheet

Design: the (C2) effectivity assembly worksheet — the campaign's route decisions, made and binding. D1: Route A (per-piece descent on cg-saturated affine pieces of the curve product; Route B degenerates — no global unit exists to seed a (C1)-style witness since L is nontrivial on the cover). D2: construct M with TRACKED DESCENT DATA, never class-only — ker(Pic R → Pic S) is Amitsur H¹(S/R,𝔾ₘ), so per-piece classes need not agree on overlaps; what glues is the per-piece descents of the ONE global σ-normalized comparison, unique up to canonical datum-compatible iso, whose canonicity kills the triple-overlap obstruction. D3: reassembly by refinement-splice over an affine basis (pieces don't trivialize M), transition data equal on the nose on overlaps, cg^*M = L by mk-calculus in the constructive direction of the kernel lemma's final assembly. D4: the σ-normalization pinned — extract cochain from the class equation, package the freedom as a global unit, rescale by the projection-pullback of the inverse section-pullback (rigidification makes that unit stateable), then lm:aut kills the triple coboundary; the section replaces (C1)'s upstairs trivialization as the source of coherence. Sub-bricks E0–E4 with delegation (E1 normalization and E3 splice Fable-authored; E0/E2/E4 Opus), staged fallbacks, kernel discipline, acceptance criteria. Campaign starts after the degree/Pic⁰ first bricks

Wave 2b CLOSED — the χ-ledger and Riemann–Roch-lite (G8+G9, the ledger keystones): h⁰/h¹/χ of a sheaf of modules with transport along sheaf isos (HModule.mapEquiv, built once at the general small-site level); the six-term slice of the covariant Ext sequence of a short exact sequence packaged with its endpoints (injectivity at H⁰ from the mono, surjectivity at H¹ into the subsingleton) and the alternating-sum identity χ(X₂) = χ(X₁) + χ(X₃); the finiteness dévissage — H⁰ and H¹ of every divisor sheaf 𝒪(D) are finite-dimensional, by Finsupp induction with per-point ℤ-recursion through the dévissage iff, from the two structure-sheaf finiteness hypotheses (properness enters only there); χ(𝒪(D)) = χ(𝒪(D − x)) + residueDeg x on the nose against the landed SES twist (devissageDivisor_eq_sub is rfl); the ledger χ(𝒪(D)) = χ(𝒪) + deg D; deg(div g) = 0 via the multiplication isomorphism and χ-invariance — the principal-divisor degree identity; the Riemann inequality deg D + χ(𝒪) ≤ h⁰(𝒪(D)) and unbounded h⁰ along multiples of any closed point (residueDeg_pos, no rational point). Curve layer keyed on the genus letI spelling: H⁰(C,𝒪) is one-dimensional via the k-linear Γ ≅ k seam (overAlgebraMapTopEquiv), the H⁰ finiteness instance partnering the landed H¹ one, χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − genus C, and RR-lite χ(𝒪(D)) = 1 − g + deg D with its curve-level corollaries. New reusable: FiniteDimensional.of_exact (extension along an exact pair over a division ring), CurveDivisor.single with its arithmetic bridges, the reusable dévissage induction principle.
